feature: Weekly P/E curves using annual EPS with synchronized range bars
architecture: P/E remains on existing stock pages and homepage workspace, with its own overview range selector synchronized to the valuation chart; one shared guide.
controls: P/E overview range bar with draggable handles and selected interval
P/E CSV now contains weekly rows and matching EPS fiscal ends
calculation: Retain every stored weekly price date. Divide each positive split-only close, or adjusted-close approximation, by latest annual basic/diluted EPS with fiscal end on or before price date. Carry EPS forward without interpolation; preserve gaps before annual coverage or with missing/non-positive EPS. Retrospective, not a filing-date backtest, TTM or forward P/E. Ratios uncapped.
annualTables: Static fiscal-year-end snapshots remain separate annual summaries and retain filing links.

versionControl: Website source folder has no Git repository. Updated source patch, live screenshot and release record saved in stock-industry-analysis for commit and push.
